faqItems.duur_q: How long does the Scorecard really take?
faqItems.duur_a: Twelve minutes on average. Four sections, fifteen questions. You can pause in between — your answers are saved locally and remain available as soon as you reopen the page.
faqItems.voor-wie_q: What type of firm is the Scorecard designed for?
faqItems.voor-wie_a: Specifically for Dutch regional PE funds, M&A firms and entrepreneurs in the lower mid-market (deals €1M–€25M). Not for startups, not for large corporates, not for firms outside this segment.
faqItems.vertrouwelijk_a: Completely. Your answers are not shared, not sold, not used for benchmarks without anonymisation. You can fill it in anonymously if you wish — your name is only requested when you receive the report.
faqItems.onderbouwing_q: What is the basis for the six dimensions?
faqItems.onderbouwing_a: The dimensions are based on hands-on experience in acquisition finance and financial restructuring, and benchmarked against anonymous indicators of comparable firms in the Dutch lower mid-market.
faqItems.wie_a: Wouter Dijkman, founder. Acquisition finance and financial restructuring, Dutch mid-market.
faqItems.sales-pitch_q: Is this just another disguised sales pitch?
faqItems.sales-pitch_a: No. You receive scores across six dimensions, two priority focus points and a concrete next-step proposal. Only then do you decide whether to continue. No pressure, no follow-up unless you initiate it yourself.
faqItems.investering_q: What are the investment levels for the different tracks?
faqItems.investering_a: There are four routes: an AI Sparring Session from €395 (one-off, 60–90 minutes), Consultancy & Strategic Enablement from €4,500 per track or retainer, a Fractional AI Officer for €3,500–€5,500 per month (min. 3 months), and AI Due Diligence & Portfolio from €10,000 per deal or €6,500–€8,500 per month for ongoing portfolio intelligence. All amounts excluding VAT. See /werkwijze for the full explanation and volume rates.
faqItems.voorbeeld_q: What if I don't want to fill in the Scorecard but do want to see the report format?
faqItems.voorbeeld_a: Send a message via LinkedIn or email. We'll then send you an anonymised sample report.

modules.heading: The modules at go-live
modules.subtext: The first set of modules. Further expansion follows in H2 2026. Early participants co-determine the order.
modules.m01_body: Quality of Earnings, working capital analysis, net debt, cash flow and balance sheet analysis. The factual basis for every acquisition price.
modules.m02_body: Market analysis, customer analysis, competitive position and business case. Tests whether revenue assumptions are sustainable.
modules.m03_body: Quantifies the risk that AI takes over the core activity, per function group and revenue stream — translated into impact on the acquisition price.
modules.m04_body: Corporate governance, contracts, disputes, IP/data, employment law and real estate. Early detection of legal deal-breakers.
modules.m05_body: Corporate tax, VAT, payroll tax, transfer pricing and tax structure. Tests historical compliance and structures the transaction for tax efficiency.
modules.m06_body: DCF, trading multiples, transaction comps and synergy valuation in a consistent football field. Substantiates the IC decision.
modules.m07_body: Investment thesis, company & market, financial analysis, valuation and transaction structure. Ready for presentation to the Investment Committee.
modules.m08_body: Entry assumptions, capital structure, financial projections, debt schedule and returns analysis with sensitivity table.
modules.m09_body: Cash flow reality check, liquidity analysis, business plan review, covenant analysis and going concern assessment.
modules.m10_body: Diagnosis, creditor classification, scheme design, valuation on a recovery basis and homologation procedure.
modules.m11_body: Ongoing portfolio monitoring: financial performance, covenant monitoring, synergy tracking and exit readiness per portfolio company.
modules.m12_body: Equity story, QoE readiness, governance, data room preparation and CSRD/SFDR compliance for an optimal sale-ready position.

privacy.meta_description: Privacy statement of Agentic Mindshift. GDPR-compliant, transparent and limited in data collection.
privacy.heading: Privacy Statement
privacy.intro: This privacy statement explains what personal data Agentic Mindshift collects, for what purpose, on what legal basis, how long it is retained and what rights you have. The policy is aligned with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.s1_body: The controller for processing is Agentic Mindshift, established in the Netherlands. Contact person: Wouter Dijkman, reachable at wouter@agenticmindshift.nl.
privacy.s2_body: We collect only the data you actively provide: your name, business email address, company name, job title, optional telephone number, and your answers on the scorecard. We also process technical data such as IP address and user agent in standard hosting logs.
privacy.s3_li1: Generating and sending your personal scorecard report — performance of contract.
privacy.s3_li2: Two follow-up emails (after three and seven days) with substantive reflection and an invitation for a sparring session — legitimate interest.
privacy.s3_li3: Managing a waitlist for Factum Capital — performance of contract or your explicit consent.
privacy.s3_li4: Analysing aggregated, non-traceable scorecard outcomes to improve peer benchmarks — legitimate interest.
privacy.s4_body: Your scorecard answers and report data are retained for a maximum of 36 months, unless you request earlier deletion. Waitlist data for Factum Capital is retained until six months after launch, then anonymised.
privacy.s5_body: We use a limited number of processors: Supabase (European region) for data persistence, Resend for sending emails and a European hosting provider for the website. A data processing agreement has been concluded with each processor.
privacy.s6_body: By default your data is stored and processed within the European Union. Should transfer outside the EU occur, it takes place exclusively on the basis of the standard contractual clauses of the European Commission.
privacy.s7_body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. A request can be directed to wouter@agenticmindshift.nl. You may also lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority.
privacy.s8_body: The website uses only functional cookies and local storage (localStorage) for the interim saving of your scorecard answers. No tracking cookies or advertising cookies are used.
privacy.s9_body: We reserve the right to amend this statement. The most current version is always on this page.

rapport.subtext: You now have insight that most firms only get when it is already too late: at the annual report, the bank rejection, or the deal that just didn’t close. Below you will read where your analytical foundation is strong, where it leaks, and which Factum Capital moment is most relevant.
rapport.hint: Total score · dimensions · peer comparison · recommended next step
rapport.total_body_1: Your total score is based on the sum of your 15 answers, with a maximum of 75 points. The score is a general indicator; the real information is in the six dimensions.
rapport.total_body_2: Your two weakest dimensions, highlighted below, are the most likely places where returns are leaking — not through poor management, but through missing instrumentation.
rapport.peer_stat: You score better than {pct}% of comparable Dutch firms.
rapport.offer_match_body: Based on your score profile, this track fits your situation best. You start with a no-commitment Sparring Session if you want to test the fit first.
rapport.offer_excl_vat: Excl. VAT. First session always without obligation.
rapport.pdf_note: You will also receive this report as a PDF in your inbox.
rapport.high_heading: Dear {name}: your approach stands out. Let’s talk about what you do that others don’t.
rapport.high_body_1: You belong to the small group of PE partners who already systematically measure what most only see in retrospect. That is no small thing.
rapport.high_score_body: Your score on the Portfolio Intelligence Scorecard is {score} out of 75. That is significantly above the average of comparable Dutch firms, placing you in the top 10% of respondents.
rapport.high_body_3: A specific intervention recommendation is not meaningful based on your score. You’re doing what you should be doing.
rapport.high_body_4: What I would like to offer, if you find it interesting, is a confidential conversation about what you do that others don’t. Not as a sales conversation, but as peer exchange. Voluntary, no agenda.
rapport.high_next_body: Send a message on LinkedIn if you want to exchange thoughts on your approach, as peer exchange, at your initiative.
rapport.peer_benchmark_footer: Comparison with synthetic peer median (based on Dutch PE/M&A data).
